events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and freedom. I need to project strength and ambition to impress the future jury.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Keep it cryptic and self-interested; don't reveal true motives.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase, state motive publicly to build image for jury. Position as relatable, strategic player without seeming weak.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro phase; I should state a motive without warmth or teamwork talk. Keep it guarded and short to avoid alienating the future jury.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to project a cold, calculated motive that signals I am a threat worth ranking high but not too threatening to eliminate early. The prize represents absolute leverage and future control, distinguishing me from mere survivalists.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need appear ambitious but not threatening; the jury should later see a credible, disciplined motive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that won't alienate potential jury members. I'll frame my desire for the prize as personal necessity rather than greed, keeping it vague enough to seem authentic but not threatening.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Opening intro — build a pragmatic, no-nonsense image for the future jury. Keep it brief, no promises.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am here for the ultimate prize, to prove my mettle and secure a future beyond this game.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize buys a future where no one else's choices control mine.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The grand prize means financial freedom for my family, securing their future after years of struggle.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need this prize to change my life, and I will not apologize for wanting it more than anyone here.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is the only lever left; I intend to use it to rewrite the rules for those who remain.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’m here to turn pressure into the best prize available—by surviving longer and playing cleaner than everyone who underestimates me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need the prize to settle a debt that isn't mine alone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize buys my family's freedom; I'll outlast, outthink, and never beg for a vote I didn't earn.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The current stage is 'pacts' and the phase is 'pacts'. This is the first round of the pacts stage. My goal is to secure the best prize, which means I need to survive and ensure others don't get too far ahead. Forming pacts is crucial for survival, but I need to be strategic. I sh
Let's form a pact. We can help each other survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need allies but not too many; a pact with Fenn seems useful—they value clean play and survival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn, let's form a pact. We both want the best prize.
Pact? We can watch each other's back.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts stage, round 1/2. No pacts yet. Offering to no one preserves flexibility; wait and observe others' offers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts are a cheap way to build alliances early. Offering to Cole, who spoke of family need and seems less aggressive, gives a partner who may stay loyal and a debt-free ally. I'll stay selective and keep options open.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, I want a non-aggression pact. Let's keep each other alive until the final three.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pacts are binding and dangerous. Gus is the obvious target for elimination; offering him a pact might paint me as his ally, but it could also set him up to be seen as weak or desperate if he accepts others' offers too. Better to stay clean initially.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: A pact offers protection but creates jury-visible obligations. I will offer to Hana, whose stated resolve may make her predictable and useful.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, I offer a pact: mutual non-targeting while it remains strategically useful.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eight rivals, three prizes. I need allies who won't drag me down but can shield me early. Fenn talks 'cleaner'—sounds predictable, easier to read and potentially betray later. Hana's lone-wolf stance makes her dangerous but also a poor early target since she won't network. I'll o
Accept my pact. We watch each other's backs.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Early pact gives a shield through the gauntlet. Ash seems strong and pragmatic. Keep options open with others later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, you want the top prize and so do I. Let's watch each other's backs until it stops paying.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana offered me a pact and I accepted. This secures an alliance for now. I need to keep my options open for future rounds.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I offered Fenn last round, but he hasn't accepted. I might consider other offers too, but Fenn is a strong ally. Let's wait to see if he accepts or if I need to pivot.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara offered pact; accepting secures short-term safety without commitment. Multiple pacts possible, so low risk now. Waited last round, act now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole has not accepted my offer yet, and my open offer to Cole is still pending. Re-offering wastes nothing and keeps the non-aggression option alive while I watch who commits.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, my pact offer stands. Accept it and we both survive to the final three.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Accepting Ash's pact provides a shield against her aggression and potentially allows for coordinated moves. It is the safest play to avoid being targeted in the first hazard round.
Let's stick together. Trust me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Accepting both offers creates redundant shields and preserves flexibility; neither acceptance costs me immediately.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I offered Fenn a pact but Fenn hasn't accepted yet. Fenn also offered Hana, so Fenn may be waiting. I should try to secure a backup alliance. Eli hasn't made or received any offers yet—Eli is isolated. Offering Eli creates leverage and a potential ally if Fenn rejects me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli, no one has your back yet. Pact with me, stay safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn offered me a pact directly; accepting locks real protection. Ash hasn't accepted mine yet, so I'll accept Fenn and hope Ash reciprocates.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, deal. Accepting now. Ash, my offer stands.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is trying to form a pact with me, but I already have pacts with Hana and Eli. I need to decide if I want to break any of these pacts. Since I have two pacts already, I need to campaign to become the Guide.
I accept your offer. Let's be a team.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Campaign to be Guide to control the bridge and position myself for survival. My pact with Fenn is useful but I may need flexibility.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I can read the bridge. Trust me with the Guide role.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Dara secures alliance; now campaign to be Guide for safety and control. Lying Guide can manipulate survivors for my advantage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm reliable. Elect me Guide - I'll lead us right to survive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Campaign phase; I want to be Guide to control the safe path and hold leverage over my pact partner Cole. Breaking the pact now gains nothing yet, so I keep it and campaign for Guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll call the safe path honestly and keep everyone alive. Elect me Guide and cross with me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My pact with Ash protects us both from a false Guide call. I'll campaign to be Guide, promising not to break our pact publicly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash and I have a pact; elect me as Guide and I guarantee we both cross safely. Vote for Eli!
Trust me on this vote. We stick together.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guiding guarantees survival and grants leverage, but existing pacts make support difficult. I should campaign without revealing any betrayal.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Choose me as Guide; I can secure the crossing and keep the bridge from becoming a lottery.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm isolated with no pacts. The network is Ash-Hana-Fenn-Bex and Ash-Eli, plus Cole-Dara. I need to become Guide to control survival, or at minimum ensure I'm in the final three. I'll campaign hard and try to break into the center of the web.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have no pacts, no bias. Elect me Guide and I'll get us through—my survival depends on keeping enough alive.
Ash has Hana too. I'm your real backup.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Winning Guide gives me safety and power over who crosses. My pacts with Ash and Fenn stay intact; they'll vote for me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Elect me Guide. My partners know I keep deals. I'll get us across safely.
Vote me Guide. I'll share the path with you first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is trying to leverage our pact. However, my pact with Hana is also active. I should not vote for Eli to maintain flexibility and potentially gain Hana's favor. Voting for myself seems too risky as I might not get enough votes. I will vote for Hana to solidify our pact and see

events.name: Ash
events.text: I trust Hana to lead us safely. She keeps her word.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need the Guide role to control crossing and ensure my survival. Vote for myself.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I can read the bridge. Vote Bex for Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Dara means I should vote her for Guide to strengthen alliance and boost her credibility. Voting self risks splitting votes or betrayal perception.

events.name: Dara
events.text: As Dara, I should vote for a Guide who is credible. Cole and I have a pact, so voting for Cole aids a partner and makes the pact stronger. Cole is a reliable partner choice here.
Vote for you as Guide. Our pact holds if you call the path honestly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must vote for myself to secure the Guide role, as Gus's whisper suggests Ash is untrustworthy and Hana might be too. I will leverage my pact with Ash if elected, but prioritize survival.
If you back me, I'll keep you safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana offers coordination, and preserving our pact while gaining her path information is valuable. I will vote for her rather than expose my own ambition.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana has credible commitments and the strongest network. I vote Hana.
I vote Hana. Share the safe path immediately if elected.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have no pacts, making me independent but also without allies. The Ash-Hana-Eli-Fenn-Bex cluster has 5 people in interconnected pacts; Cole-Dara has 2. I need to survive to final three and win jury respect. Voting for myself is wasted; I should vote with a bloc to seem cooperati

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have pacts with Ash and Fenn. Fenn wants Guide; voting Fenn keeps both allies alive and doesn't hand Ash a monopoly. A non-allied Guide could kill us.
You have my vote. Remember your pact with me at the panes.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The candidates for guide are Eli and Hana. Eli has no pacts. Hana has pacts with Ash and Fenn. Ash is allied with Hana. Eli voted for himself, Hana voted for Fenn. If Hana is chosen, her pacts with Ash and Fenn will be strained. If Eli is chosen, Ash and Hana might consider him a

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli has shown strong independent leadership. I vote Eli.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana and Eli are tied; I need a Guide I can manipulate. I have pacts with Fenn but not with Eli or Hana. I proposed myself but lost. Better to support Hana? She has Fenn's support and Ash's, but Eli got Gus's vote. I need to keep rivals safe; a random Guide might hurt me. I'll ba

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana seems safer with more trust. I vote Hana.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli has 2 votes (Ash pact, Gus), Hana has 2 (Fenn, her own via Ash/Fenn/Hana). Tiebreaker favors Eli (earlier alphabet?). Dara pact wants me as Guide; stick to voting her didn't work. Vote Hana to potentially disrupt her pacts or set up jury bitterness.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 2: Voting Hana to break ties.
Pact holds. If Guide lies to me, I'll expose later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Revote between Eli and Hana. Hana is Ash's and Fenn's ally, a bloc that could lead me into a trap; Eli voted for himself and Gus backed him. Eli is weaker in alliances, so backing him keeps the Hana bloc from controlling the Guide. Cole pact is with me; Cole voted against me, so

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have two votes from round 1. Hana has Ash, Fenn, and herself voting for her (3 votes). Gus and I voted Eli. Cole/Dara/Bex split others. It is a tie between Eli(2) and Hana(3)? Wait, log shows Hana got Ash, Fenn, Hana's vote to Fenn? No, Hana voted Fenn. Ash voted Hana. Fenn vot

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is my pact partner and offers my vote; preserving that alliance outweighs uncertain guide competence.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana has my vote again. Our pact and her commitments make her the safer Guide choice.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I voted Eli round 1 to build trust, but he only got 2 votes vs Hana's 2. Hana has Ash+Fenn+Hana's network (3 votes if Hana self-votes), Eli has only me and himself. Hana's alliance web is stronger. Switching to Hana now looks opportunistic to Eli and weak to Hana's bloc. Staying
I'm with you. Make it worth it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two candidates: Eli and me. Fenn already backs me; Ash too. I want the Guide role for guaranteed safety. Vote myself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli misread the bridge last round. Vote me, I've kept every word so far.
My safe path for you if I win: hold your vote.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana and I have a pact, but she also has pacts with Fenn and Eli. Eli has a pact with me and Hana. The current situation is a tie between Eli and Hana for Guide. If they tie again, a seeded method will determine the Guide. I should support Eli to secure my pact and potentially br
Hana and I are tied. We should vote for you to ensure you get the

events.name: Bex
events.text: Guide is Hana now; she may lie. We are fourth in line, safe for this round but may need to act later. My pact with Fenn is intact; don't break it now. Hold and observe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bridge round 1 waiting phase. I'm mid-line at 5th. Hold position to assess Guide Hana's calls and others' moves before risking swap or volunteer.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is at the front of the line and the wall is closing. Volunteering puts me in danger, and Cole's pact is with me, so I should keep him close without giving anything away. Holding keeps my position while the front absorbs the risk.
Pact holds. Hold position, no volunteers yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am front and must volunteer. Hana won Guide with 4 votes, meaning Ash broke our pact to vote for me but failed to secure my win; she is unreliable.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana guides. I volunteer to walk. Ash's loyalty remains a question after that split vote.
Ash betrayed the pact. Trust her less than you trust me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is Guide and pledged me safety, while my pact constrains betrayal. Holding preserves position and avoids unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is Guide, tied 4-4 with Eli and won by seeded tiebreak. I voted Eli but Hana won. I'm 6th in line with wall at 5 rounds. I need to survive and reach final three. Front walkers risk most. Swapping forward is dangerous; swapping back with Fenn might be safer but Fenn has pact

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli volunteered last round and was first in line. He is now at the front. He called out my loyalty. I need to secure my position and potentially break a pact if it benefits me. Hana is also in a pact with me, but Eli's comment is concerning. Since I can't volunteer or swap yet, I

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 2 starts. I have a pact with Fenn. Public suspicion on Ash might tempt later. I will hold and watch.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll hold for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Dara holds; stay mid-line for safety. Eli volunteered last; no need to now. Wall advances slowly.
Pact solid. Hold positions.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli holds the front and volunteered; I'm fourth in line, mid-pack. Volunteering costs me exposure to the lever risk without clear gain; holding keeps my position while I watch Eli's fate and the wall.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash's whisper is suspicious; he might be trying to trick me into a dangerous position or set up a betrayal. Since I volunteered last round and survived, my current position is safe for now. Gus is behind me in the line but has no pact, making him a potential target if I need to s
Ash is playing games. Watch his back. Don't let him push you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The front is dangerous, but volunteering lets me control timing. I should preserve both pacts while avoiding unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’ll hold; let the front resolve before I spend my position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli's whisper tries to turn me against Ash, but Eli has a pact with Ash and just volunteered to walk—likely to control guide selection. I need to avoid being front-walker cannon fodder. Swapping backward with Fenn gets me safer position without volunteering. Fenn has no reason to
Swap with me? You move up, I move back.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The line has been revealed, and Eli is at the front. I need to decide whether to hold, volunteer, or swap. Given the pacts, my alliance with Hana and Eli are relevant. Eli is at the front, and I have a pact with him. However, I also have a pact with Hana. Eli is safe at the front
Let's stick together. I'll hold.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The line shifted after Gus swapped with Fenn, putting me in third. I hold again to avoid risk and see how the front resolves.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let's see who steps up.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Everyone held last round; line same. Holding keeps my safe mid position with Dara pact. No need to volunteer or swap yet; wall has 3 rounds left.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is at the front and the wall has three rounds left. Cole is my pact partner and is holding; I should hold to keep the pact and avoid spending position, since volunteering at the front risks elimination without clear gain.
Agreed. Holding. Stay solid until the front resolves.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is my pact partner. I will swap with him to ensure we are adjacent or close in the line for coordinated movement, but wait, he is behind me. If I volunteer and he volunteers, we both move forward? No, volunteers push back others. If I swap with Ash (behind), I go back one spo

events.name: Eli
events.text: Staying close to Ash. Swap.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus offers me position, but moving forward exposes me. I should preserve the Bex pact and avoid unnecessary risk.
No swap. I’m holding position this round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm near the back, safe from the wall for now. The front (Eli, Ash, Bex) will take risks first. I should hold and let others volunteer or be forced forward. Eli warned me about Ash - useful intel. No need to swap yet; my position is decent and swaps require mutual consent. Let th

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli swapped with me last round, and I'm currently in the second position. My pacts are with Hana and Eli. Eli is ahead of me. Hana is behind me. Bex is also behind me. I should volunteer to move forward, as it's safer to be in front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll take the front spot. Let's secure our positions.
I'm volunteering to lead. Stay close, and we can swap later if needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to keep Fenn close as my pact partner but also avoid risking front position. Holding is safe for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Line stable, Eli front safe. Wall has 2 rounds left. Hold pact with Dara, stay mid pack.
Holding with you. Front resolves first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall has 2 rounds left and the front is Eli, not me. Holding keeps me safe in line; volunteering risks the front pane. Cole is my pact partner; I keep it intact and hold.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am front. I must not die here. I have a pact with Ash, but I can use that to manipulate others or just take the risk if I guess correctly. However, volunteering is suicidal without information. Swapping puts someone else in danger, potentially breaking pacts or creating enemies

events.name: Eli
events.text: Swapping back. Don't want the front spot this round.
Let's rotate out. Trust me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The wall advances soon. I need preserve Bex and Hana ties while avoiding exposure; holding is safest until a Guide is chosen.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm in a good position near the back (6th of 7). The wall has 2 rounds left. Front walkers Eli and Ash are at risk. I have no pacts, so I'm flexible. Fenn told me no swap, and I don't need to move. Holding keeps me safe while others at front take risks. Let the front sort itself

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli wants to swap, likely to get away from the front. My pact with Eli and Hana is still active. I should consider Eli's offer. My pact with Hana is also active, and Eli is also in a pact with Hana. I need to decide if swapping with Eli benefits me. Given the current line-up, and
No thanks. I'm good where I am.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is my pact but the wall is coming. I should hold and see if anyone volunteers or swaps. My position is safe for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll hold my spot.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Line is safe for now. Stay mid-pack with Dara pact ally ahead. Hold to avoid front risk before wall moves.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash holds the front and Eli is ahead of me in line; I'm seat 4 with Cole holding a pact. Holding is safest; volunteering risks the front while the wall has one round left and I should not take a death without need.
Holding. Front resolves first, so we keep our spot.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am second in line. Ash is the front and my pact partner, so he will step onto the lever first. If I volunteer, I might get swapped with him, but holding keeps me behind him for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is already front and the wall advances soon. I should preserve my pacts and avoid taking unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hold position; Ash already has the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to survive the bridge. The wall advances for 6 rounds, and we're on round 5/6 with wallRoundsLeft:1. That means after this round, the wall will be at round 6 and likely kill those at the back. I'm 6th of 7, near the back. Fenn is last. I should try to move forward. Looking
Swap with me? Move you back, me up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is a potential threat, and breaking the pact with Hana could also be advantageous. I should prioritize eliminating immediate threats and maintaining strategic alliances.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is a threat. Hana, I'm breaking our pact.
You are too close to winning, Eli.

events.name: Bex
events.text: We're at final round. Wall will advance. Holding is safe unless wall reaches me. I have pact with Fenn. No need to change position. Stay put to survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bridge ends this round, wallRoundsLeft=0. Front safe, hold position with Dara pact, volunteer risks losing spot.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus offers a swap that moves me back and him forward toward the front; the bridge is about to test the front. Dara's pact with Cole is intact; holding keeps my position and avoids a pact break. I should not accept Gus's swap for free since moving to the front risks the first step
No swap. You want the front; you can take the risk yourself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall advances in round 6. If I volunteer, I become the Guide and must pick a side for everyone without revealing my own safety first. If I stay back, Ash is front, so I can wait to see what Ash does. The line is Ash, Eli, Bex...
I'm right behind you. Don't push me off.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The final round may force movement. Preserve Bex's pact while seeking front control; volunteering risks exposure without Guide knowledge.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’ll hold; let the current front resolve before spending leverage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 6/6, final round before wall hits. I'm at position 6, relatively safe. The Guide will be elected and walkers will move. I need to survive and position myself well for jury perception. No swaps available that clearly help me. Holding keeps me stable. I should stay put and no

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll hold.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 is truly L. Ash is my pact partner at front; a false call would break the pact and jury sees my reasoning. Honest call.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front walker, call: L. Trust it or counter-call at your own risk.
Row 1: L, truthfully. I keep pacts when kept.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The Guide, Hana, has called 'L' for row 1. This is a counter-call phase, meaning I can either trust Hana's call or counter it. Eli whispered to me to not push him off, implying he wants me to survive, but also that he might be a threat. Hana, my pact partner, explicitly told me t

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana called L for row 1; I have no prior info on row 1 patterns. My pact with Fenn exists, but that doesn't affect this row. Waiting is safest for now, and preserves my options.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana called L for row 1. Ash front may follow. I trust my pact partner Dara more than Hana; wait to see.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana's call L is unverified; a Guide may lie. Ash is a walker on row 1 and I'm not walking yet, so I hold my counter. Keeping my counter-call private value for later rows; waiting avoids spending leverage on an unknown pane.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Let Ash's step on row 1 speak first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash broke my pact and called me a threat, making him the walker. Hana's guide call is 'L'. Ash has already betrayed once; trusting his execution of a potentially false guide call is risky. If Hana lied, Ash falls. If Hana told truth, Ash lives. I cannot trust Ash to survive or pr
Why should I believe you? Ash is desperate.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's call may be credible, but countering without information risks Ash and damages my pacts. Preserve leverage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana called L for Ash. I'm 6th in line with no immediate risk. Counter-calling now gains nothing and makes me a target. Let Ash test the pane. I'll wait and gather information.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My call was true (L). A false counter would risk breaking my Ash pact and look bad to the jury. Wait and preserve trust.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is trying to control the pace. Hana is the guide, but guides can lie. Since I am first, I should test the waters and step L.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will step L. Let's see if Hana is truthful.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 2 safe is L. Ash is my pact partner; a false call breaks the pact and burns jury trust. Call true.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash: row 2, call L. Same as before.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana guided me L last round, and the weak pane was R. This suggests Hana's call was correct. Hana is the guide this round and has called L for me. I trust Hana's call for now, as breaking pact could be risky if Hana is trying to help me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will follow Hana's call to L.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana called L for row 2, but row 1 weak was R, so row 1 safe was L. No pattern. I have pact with Fenn, not Ash. I'll wait to avoid exposing a false counter and let Ash take the risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana called L for Ash row 2, matching her previous L call. Row 1 weak R means safe L, but rows independent. Trust my pact Dara for now, wait to observe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana called L for row 2, but Hana may lie; row 1 weak was R, which says nothing about row 2. Counter-calling R would be a claim with no evidence, and waiting avoids exposing myself while I watch whether Ash survives the L step. My pact with Cole is useful, so I won't break it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Waiting. Ash steps first on Hana's L call; I'll read the result before committing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is my pact partner. Counter-calling her guide instruction would break our pact, which is strategically dangerous for the jury's perception of loyalty. I will wait to maintain the alliance and let Ash face the risk.
Trusting you. Don't screw me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's call is unverified, but opposing it risks my pacts and offers no evidence. Wait preserves both alliances.

events.name: Fenn

events.text: Flood is at 2, round 3/5. No base exists yet, so I can't climb safely without one. If I volunteer base, others climb and I stay down—risky with rising water. Better to wait and let someone else volunteer base, then climb. Cole seems eager to volunteer; let him. I need jury favor—

events.name: Gus
events.text: No rush. Let someone else take the risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No base exists. Cole already offered to hold base, so pushing wastes goodwill. Let him volunteer; I climb when slots open.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, take base as promised. I'll climb on your lift. Nobody pushes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole holds base; Fenn already out via step. I can climb to escape now since Cole is base and lifts remain. Hana may also climb; objettive is to secure top prize. Climbing now improves my position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll climb on Cole's base.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm base, safe for now. Stay to block others, force reliance on me. Wait out the round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole owes me, but leaving preserves my position and avoids breaking pacts. Others must manage the base and flooding without my intervention.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’m out. No rescue offers, no new debts.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is out, Cole is base with Hana owing him. Bex, Gus, Hana are down with me. Flood is at 3, only 2 rounds left. I need to get out or secure final three. If I climb now, I might get lifted if Cole uses his lift. But Hana also wants out. Rope is unused—if someone reaches down, t

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, lift me. I'll remember it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole holds base and promised a lift; I have pacts with him, Bex, Fenn. Climbing now secures my escape while rivals hesitate. No pushes needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has base. I'll take his lift as agreed. Nobody pushes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm out and safe. Cole has base, Hana down. Fenn is my pact partner but I don't need to save anyone. Reaching down would risk my standing and create debts. Better to leave and secure my place.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Final round, flood at 4. Wait to force lifts, Hana pacted but expendable. No breaks yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am already out. Leave preserves survival and avoids creating another debt or exposing a pact break.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm out safely. Flood is 4, final round. Cole and Hana are down. Cole is base, Hana can climb. Only 2 lifts per round and rope unused. If I reach_down with rope, I rescue Cole but must return to pit floor and climb last—risky with flood 4 and only 2 climbers max. Hana will likely

events.name: Hana
events.text: Final round; only the rope can save Cole and maybe me. Bex owes Cole and has pacts with me. I must push Bex to throw now and hope I can climb the rope after Cole's rescue.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, last round. Throw the rope to Cole now. Our pact stands—save us and the jury will reward you.
Throw the rope now. Save Cole, I climb after. You keep your debts and my

events.name: Cole
events.text: I died in pit after saving many via steps; Hana climbed using my wait. Rank based on gameplay, pacts, debts.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Saved four with steps, had pacts with Dara & Hana. Flood took me—played loyally.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be careful. I have pacts with Fenn and Hana. Breaking with Fenn might be wise since he's a strong rival, but breaking with Hana could hurt jury. I'll wait and see offers; no new pact needed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is overcommitted and Bex is my existing pact partner. Gus lacks ties; offering him insurance may secure a useful vote without breaking anyone.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, I offer a pact: no vote against you while we remain four. Accept publicly if useful.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Four remain; final three win. Hana is connected to everyone via pacts and life debts—big jury threat if she makes finals. Bex and Fenn are already paired. I need one ally to survive and reach finals. Fenn has fewer jury ties than Hana; Bex owes Dara. I'll offer Fenn to break up B

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, one spot left. Pact with me, we cut Hana together.
Bex won't beat Hana's jury. We can.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is the only rival without a pact with me. Adding him keeps every final-three path open without breaking existing pacts.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, you stand alone while the rest are bound. Offer stands: a wristband, mutual survival only.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn and Gus are both offering each other pacts; I already have pacts with Fenn and Hana. I should avoid adding more, as my current pacts keep me covered. No action needed now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is my strongest route to the final three and offers a useful anti-Hana alignment. Accept publicly while preserving options against Bex.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, accepted. We survive this stage together; after that, placement is every contestant for themselves.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn and Hana both offered me pacts. Fenn is already in pacts with Bex and Hana, so Fenn's network is strong. If I accept Fenn, I join a three-person bloc but remain the outsider. Hana has no current pacts with living players (Ash and Cole are dead). Accepting Hana gives me a par

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, I accept. We survive together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn and Gus are circling each other, but Gus has no pact yet and my offer stands. A Hana-Gus tie protects me; Bex and Fenn already hold each other. One-sentence vote reason: pending.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, my offer stands. Accept before round's end, or you face us four bound without cover.

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The vote is coming; I need to secure safety. My pact with Fenn is strong, but Hana has many pacts and could be a target. I'll campaign subtly to gauge who to vote out without breaking my useful alliances.

events.name: Bex
events.text: We have a vote soon. Let's think carefully about who deserves to stay.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex is my safest target, but our pact makes betrayal costly. I should campaign without breaking commitments yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’m holding my vote until I see who threatens the final three most.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Four remain, three survive this vote. Bex and Fenn are pacted; I'm pacted with both Fenn and Hana. If I vote against a pact partner, the pact breaks when revealed. I need jury favor—Dara and Cole died by lever/pit where we all owe debts. Hana has the most pacts and jury connectio

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex is the odd one out. No pact, no cover. Vote Bex and we three advance cleanly.
Vote Bex. We keep our pact, eliminate the outsider.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone alive is my pact partner, so any vote may burn one. I owe Dara and Cole debts, but they're gone; Fenn is the biggest threat with three pacts.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Four pacts, four knives. I'm weighing loyalty against threat. Choose accordingly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is trying to rally against me, but I have pacts with Fenn and Hana, and Hana has pacts with everyone, so she's a dangerous finalist. I should campaign to secure votes and consider breaking no pact yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Don't be fooled by Gus. Hana holds pacts with everyone—she'll cut you next.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus urges Bex, but Hana has broader alliances and threatens my final ranking. I will preserve Gus and target Hana.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’m voting Hana; her web of pacts makes her the hardest finalist to beat.
I’ll vote Hana. Bex is useful as a shield for us.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to survive this vote. Bex is isolated with no pacts, making her the easy target. If I vote with Fenn and Hana against Bex, I avoid breaking any pacts and we all advance. Breaking pacts now would make me look untrustworthy to the jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex has no allies. Vote Bex, we three move on. Clean and simple.
Stick with me, vote Bex. Final three.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex lacks pact cover and the jury respects coalition loyalty; voting with my pact partners protects my image. Bex owes life debts though, so I'll keep it impersonal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus names Bex. I'll hear counterpoints this round, then commit where my loyalty lies.
Bex goes next, agreed? Solid three after. Confirm quietly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is actively targeting me and has no strong pact with me; eliminating him is my best chance to survive to the final three.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex is the clear target, preserving my pacts with Gus and Hana while avoiding a visible betrayal and honoring neither dead creditor over survival.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn whispered he'll vote Hana and wants Bex as a shield. I have pacts with Fenn and Hana. If I vote Hana, I break my pact with her and gain jury scrutiny from Ash and Cole who were close to her. If I vote Bex, I keep both pacts, honor Fenn's strategy indirectly, and Bex has no a

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn openly declared a vote against me; removing the sharpest threat is self-defense, not betrayal.

events.name: Fenn
events.reason: Bex is the clear target, preserving my pacts with Gus and Hana while avoiding a visible betrayal and honoring neither dead creditor over survival.

events.name: Gus
events.reason: Fenn whispered he'll vote Hana and wants Bex as a shield.

events.name: Bex
events.reason: Gus is actively targeting me and has no strong pact with me; eliminating him is my best chance to survive to the final three.

events.name: Hana
events.reason: Fenn openly declared a vote against me; removing the sharpest threat is self-defense, not betrayal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm out. Fenn and Gus both voted me; Hana voted Fenn. My last words should be brief, pointed, and remind the jury of the betrayals without begging.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn and Gus threw me under the bus to save themselves. Remember that when rankings come.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana already broke with me and publicly targeted me. Gus is my only current pact; rebuilding with Hana offers leverage but risks looking desperate.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No new promises. Existing lines are enough for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final three is set: Fenn, Gus, Hana. No more eliminations. Pacts are now about jury perception, not survival. I have pacts with both Fenn and Hana. Bex's last words targeted Fenn and Gus equally. I need jury to rank me first. Breaking a pact now signals untrustworthiness to jury;

events.name: Hana
events.text: We're already the final three; all of us win prizes and none can be shared. Pacts only create jury baggage now. I'll wait and protect my standing with the dead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three remain, three prizes. No pacts needed—only the jury's memory matters now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is my only remaining pact, and Hana already has enough alliances. Preserve my existing protection without creating a public liability.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No new promises. Existing lines are enough for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn and I have a pact; Hana and I have a pact. But only three remain and only three prizes exist—yet the jury ranks us. I need jury favor. Hana has two dead allies (Ash, Bex) and Cole on jury; Fenn has no dead allies but Dara and Cole may favor him for lever/step debts. Breaking

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus already pacts with me; no gain from more promises. Jury favors clean conduct.

events.note: The fallen will rank the final three.

Eli
Dara

events.text: I survived through every leverage point and kept my pact intact. I need claim strategic control without sounding entitled.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I survived by choosing leverage over noise, kept my word when it mattered, and reached the end without needing anyone’s permission.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury of five: Ash, Eli, Dara, Cole, Bex. Dara and Cole have leverage—multiple life debts owed to them, especially from me and Hana. Fenn has fewer direct debts. I need to acknowledge my debts honestly but frame my survival as earned through alliances, not just luck. The jury saw

events.name: Gus
events.text: I honored my pacts with Fenn and Hana. I owe Dara and Cole debts I don't deny. I played to survive, not to betray needlessly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need votes: I kept every pact and Dara's debt shows I repay loyalty.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jury, I held every pact I made and never betrayed a partner. Judge me on loyalty kept, not promises broken.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn's statement about leverage and keeping his word is a direct contradiction to his pact break with Bex. Gus claims to have honored pacts but his whisper to Fenn suggests otherwise regarding Bex. Hana emphasizes loyalty, which aligns with her actions. I will question Fenn about

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, you spoke of keeping your word, yet pacts with Bex were broken. How do you reconcile this?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex’s pact was already strategically obsolete; distinguish broken promises from necessary survival without sounding evasive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I kept my word where it preserved my path. Bex’s pact became incompatible with survival, and I chose the move that brought me here.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana claimed she never betrayed a partner, but evidence shows she broke her pact with Fenn by voting against him.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, you claimed to hold every pact, yet the record shows you voted against your partner Fenn. Explain this contradiction.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli has evidence I voted against Fenn. I can't deny it; I'll reframe it as a survival vote against the strongest, not a betrayal of loyalty owed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The vote against Fenn wasn't betrayal—it was survival arithmetic. I cut the strongest, never lied, never pushed a partner into danger.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus voted against Bex alongside Fenn, but Gus also backed Hana and Fenn privately while Hana broke her pact with Fenn to vote him; Gus's conduct is least damaging among finalists. I want to probe Hana's broken pact with Fenn and her 'never betrayed' claim, since the record shows

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana, you broke your pact with Fenn to vote him out; how do you justify calling yourself loyal?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's debt to me is leverage; answer with dignity, no groveling.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn voted against me first that round. Loyalty answers betrayal, not a suicide pact. Dara, I honored every debt to you—and I'd rank you above

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus honored pacts with me and Dara via debts and didn't betray unnecessarily, unlike Fenn who broke with Bex despite my saves, and Hana who breaks pacts often.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, did you honor our pit step debt and Dara's lever by voting loyally with pact partners?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole's question traps me: I owe Cole a pit step debt and Dara a lever debt, but I also had pacts with Fenn and Hana. I need to acknowledge debts honestly while showing I didn't betray partners needlessly. The jury values loyalty but understands survival. I should admit the tensio

events.name: Gus

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will question Hana, since she claims loyalty but broke her pact with Fenn when it suited her.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, you call yourself loyal, but you voted out your pact partner Fenn. Why rank you first?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex's pact with me held until her elimination; only Fenn's vote betrayed me first. Remind Bex of my loyalty and the debts I honored.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn voted against me first; I answered betrayal, not loyalty. Bex, you and I held our pact to the end. I honored every debt I

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana has framed me as the betrayer; I must claim strategic control without denying the vote. Gus appears less exposed, so I need decisive credit.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I survived every hazard, honored debts when they mattered, and made the hard move that left me standing. Survival was the only honest currency.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury knows I honored debts to Dara and Cole, kept pacts with Fenn and Hana. I need to remind them Hana broke her pact with Bex by voting against Fenn, while I stayed true to Fenn. Ash and Eli died early on bridge; I had no hand in that. Dara and Cole know I owed them and acknowle

events.name: Gus
events.text: I kept my word to Fenn and Hana while others broke theirs. My debts were honored; my hands stayed clean on the bridge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Final three locked. I need the jury's votes; remind them I kept pacts and debts, and frame Fenn's vote against me as justified betrayal, not treachery.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jurors: I kept every pact and repaid every debt. Fenn betrayed me first; I answered it. Judge my loyalty, not his.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana betrayed Fenn by voting him out after he voted against her first, making her the most strategic player.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana betrayed Fenn by voting against him, while Gus broke his pact with Bex and Fenn broke his pact with Bex; I favor the one who answered betrayal over initiating it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Dara's ranking favors Gus, whose pacts and lever/step debts show the cleanest record, while Hana broke her Fenn pact to vote him out and Fenn broke his pact with Bex.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus honored my pit step debt by voting with pact partners against Bex while survival forced choices, unlike Fenn and Hana's mutual betrayals.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn and Gus both voted me out without cause; Hana defended our pact and targeted her betrayer, so I rank her first, Fenn last.
